name: cloudnote-workspace
description: 云笔记 — Electron 桌面端 + Node 同步服务

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run server" "npm run app"
scripts.test:sync: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix app run test:sync
